name: Google Calendar (free/busy only)
description: Google Calendar free/busy only (scope calendar.freebusy): POST /freeBusy returns busy intervals for calendars, never event details. Auth: drawlatch mints short-lived access tokens from GOOGLE_OAUTH_CLIENT_ID, GOOGLE_OAUTH_CLIENT_SECRET and GOOGLE_OAUTH_REFRESH_TOKEN (user OAuth; the agent never sees them) and refuses any token broader than this scope. See CONNECTIONS.md "Google (scoped)".

testConnection.description: Queries free/busy for the primary calendar over a fixed one-hour window (read-only)
